title: Perfection!
text: Perfection!. Just what I wanted exactly what I needed and arrived fast and in good conditions, I already had one of these but I wanted a second one and also I know from having it that it's great! Very easy to clean, works exactly as it's supposed to and it holds up to 4 sponges or 2 small and 1 fat one, I like it because it's very practical I will never buy a different one again! That's just how good this is! Worth to have in your sink.
